shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP run any CLI command using REST api/private/cli/

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: params
options.description: a dictionary of parameters to pass into the api call

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: This module only supports REST. always -- will always use the REST API. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: verb
options.description: Define which action to perform with the provided command. Values are mapped to show, create, modify, delete. OPTIONS is useful to know which verbs are supported by the REST API
